name: ACT
tonnage_source: ACT Legislative Assembly, answer to QON 055 (TCCSD, Recycling and waste policy, Feb 2025): Household Waste tonnes 2023-24
cv_source: audit: ACT NoWaste 2022 Domestic Kerbside Bin Audit, Table 9 general-waste composition (SD/MUD weighted by Table 4 tonnes) x energy per material (site/data/redbin_composition.csv); ACT "other organics" (soiled paper, composite paper, animal waste, compostables, timber) counted with paper at 15 MJ/kg, textiles at 16; packaged food counted as food (4.65). Sensitivity: other organics at 10 MJ/kg gives 10.59 MJ/kg (range 10.59-11.51)
waste_notes: 80,461 t = TCCS measured household (red-bin) waste 2023-24; the QON answer does not define the term, we read it as the red bin (0.168 t/person on 2024 ERP, in line with NSW metro). The 2022 audit figure of 64,462 t (SDs 52,231 + MUDs 12,231) is an extrapolation from an April 2022 sample on 2021 Census household counts and already includes MUDs. Organics: garden bins 24,510 t + FOGO pilot 1,224 t (2023-24). Composition shares: food 38.0%, paper 27.7%, plastics 13.2%, other 9.0%, other_organics 5.2%, glass_metal 4.1%, garden 2.8%
